# Minecraft 1.8.9 Packet Reference — llms.txt
# https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/

> Searchable reference for all 105 Minecraft 1.8.9 network packets — fields, wire encoding, MCP classes, real client examples and anti-cheat notes.
> Plus 16 verbatim MCP logic-class sources with deep analysis, module index and module analyses.

## Packets (105)
### Handshaking (1)
- [C00Handshake 0x00 — Handshake](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C00Handshake/): The very first packet sent by the client. Initiates the connection and requests a protocol state transition.
### Login → Server (2)
- [C00PacketLoginStart 0x00 — Login Start](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C00PacketLoginStart/): Starts the login process by sending the player's GameProfile (username) to the server.
- [C01PacketEncryptionResponse 0x01 — Encryption Response](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C01PacketEncryptionResponse/): Responds to the server's encryption request with the shared secret (RSA-encrypted with the server's public key) and verify token.
### Login → Client (4)
- [S00PacketDisconnect 0x00 — Login Disconnect](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S00PacketDisconnect/): Kicks the client during the login phase with a JSON chat component reason message (e.g. 'You are banned', 'Server is full').
- [S01PacketEncryptionRequest 0x01 — Encryption Request](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S01PacketEncryptionRequest/): Requests the client to enable encryption by sending the server's RSA public key, a verify token (random challenge), and server ID for Mojang session auth.
- [S02PacketLoginSuccess 0x02 — Login Success](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S02PacketLoginSuccess/): Confirms successful authentication. Contains the player's UUID and username. Transitions the connection state from LOGIN to PLAY.
- [S03PacketEnableCompression 0x03 — Enable Compression](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S03PacketEnableCompression/): Enables zlib compression for all subsequent packets. Sets the compression threshold — packets >= this size are compressed.
### Status → Server (2)
- [C00PacketServerQuery 0x00 — Status Request](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C00PacketServerQuery/): Requests the server's status (MOTD, player count, favicon, protocol version). Empty packet with no payload.
- [C01PacketPing 0x01 — Ping](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C01PacketPing/): Sends a client-side timestamp for the server to echo back. The client calculates round-trip latency from the difference.
### Status → Client (2)
- [S00PacketServerInfo 0x00 — Server Status](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S00PacketServerInfo/): Responds to C00PacketServerQuery with the server's status as a JSON string (MOTD, players, version, favicon, mod info).
- [S01PacketPong 0x01 — Pong](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S01PacketPong/): Echoes back the exact client timestamp from C01PacketPing. The client calculates round-trip latency from the difference.
### Play → Server (23)
- [C00PacketKeepAlive 0x00 — Keep Alive (Response)](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C00PacketKeepAlive/): Response to S00PacketKeepAlive. The client echoes back the server's keep-alive ID.
- [C01PacketChatMessage 0x01 — Chat Message](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C01PacketChatMessage/): Sends a chat message or command from the client to the server.
- [C02PacketUseEntity 0x02 — Use Entity](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C02PacketUseEntity/): Player interacts with (attacks or right-clicks) an entity.
- [C03PacketPlayer 0x03 — Player](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C03PacketPlayer/): Updates the player's position on the server. Has subclasses for different update types.
- [C07PacketPlayerDigging 0x07 — Player Digging](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C07PacketPlayerDigging/): Player starts/cancels/ends mining a block, or drops an item (press Q).
- [C08PacketPlayerBlockPlacement 0x08 — Player Block Placement](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C08PacketPlayerBlockPlacement/): Player places a block or uses an item. Can also be used for empty-hand interactions (e.g., pressing buttons).
- [C09PacketHeldItemChange 0x09 — Held Item Change](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C09PacketHeldItemChange/): Player changes their selected hotbar slot.
- [C0APacketAnimation 0x0A — Animation](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C0APacketAnimation/): Player swings their arm (left click or server-side swing). Empty packet with no payload.
- [C0BPacketEntityAction 0x0B — Entity Action](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C0BPacketEntityAction/): Player performs an action: crouch, uncrouch, sprint, stop sprint, leave bed, jump with horse, open inventory.
- [C0CPacketInput 0x0C — Input](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C0CPacketInput/): Player steers a vehicle (boat or horse). Sends sideways/forward movement, jump flag, and unmount flag.
- [C0DPacketCloseWindow 0x0D — Close Window](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C0DPacketCloseWindow/): Player closes an inventory window (chest, crafting table, furnace, etc).
- [C0EPacketClickWindow 0x0E — Click Window](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C0EPacketClickWindow/): Player clicks in an inventory window. Handles item moves: pickup, shift-click, number key swap, middle click, drop, drag init, and double-click.
- [C0FPacketConfirmTransaction 0x0F — Confirm Transaction](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C0FPacketConfirmTransaction/): Client confirms receipt of a S32PacketConfirmTransaction (server inventory transaction).
- [C10PacketCreativeInventoryAction 0x10 — Creative Inventory Action](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C10PacketCreativeInventoryAction/): Player sets the contents of a slot in creative mode. Used to spawn items or modify inventory contents directly.
- [C11PacketEnchantItem 0x11 — Enchant Item](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C11PacketEnchantItem/): Player selects an enchantment option in the enchanting table window. Carries window ID and button (0=top, 1=middle, 2=bottom).
- [C12PacketUpdateSign 0x12 — Update Sign](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C12PacketUpdateSign/): Player finishes editing a sign. Sends the block position and four lines of text as IChatComponents.
- [C13PacketPlayerAbilities 0x13 — Player Abilities](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C13PacketPlayerAbilities/): Player toggles flying state. Only sent for the flying flag change — the server controls all other ability flags via S39PacketPlayerAbilities.
- [C14PacketTabComplete 0x14 — Tab Complete](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C14PacketTabComplete/): Player presses Tab in chat to request auto-completion. Sends the partial message or command.
- [C15PacketClientSettings 0x15 — Client Settings](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C15PacketClientSettings/): Client sends its locale, view distance, chat mode, chat colors, difficulty preference, and cape visibility.
- [C16PacketClientStatus 0x16 — Client Status](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C16PacketClientStatus/): Client sends a status update: respawn after death or open inventory (to achieve).
- [C17PacketCustomPayload 0x17 — Custom Payload (Plugin Message)](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C17PacketCustomPayload/): Sends a plugin channel message from client to server. Used for mod communication.
- [C18PacketSpectate 0x18 — Spectate](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C18PacketSpectate/): Spectator mode player teleports to another entity or player by UUID. Only works in spectator gamemode (3).
- [C19PacketResourcePackStatus 0x19 — Resource Pack Status](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/C19PacketResourcePackStatus/): Client reports the resource pack load status to the server. Sent after S48PacketResourcePackSend.
### Play → Client (71)
- [S00PacketKeepAlive 0x00 — Keep Alive (Request)](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S00PacketKeepAlive/): Server sends a keep-alive ID that the client must echo back in C00PacketKeepAlive.
- [S01PacketJoinGame 0x01 — Join Game](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S01PacketJoinGame/): Welcomes the player into the world. Sends entity ID, gamemode, dimension, difficulty, max players, world type, and reduced debug info.
- [S02PacketChat 0x02 — Chat Message](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S02PacketChat/): Server sends a chat message or command response to the client.
- [S03PacketTimeUpdate 0x03 — Time Update](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S03PacketTimeUpdate/): Synchronizes the world time (total world age and day/night cycle time). Sent every few seconds or when time accelerates (sleeping).
- [S04PacketEntityEquipment 0x04 — Entity Equipment](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S04PacketEntityEquipment/): Updates an entity's equipped item in a specific slot (main hand, armor slots).
- [S05PacketSpawnPosition 0x05 — Spawn Position](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S05PacketSpawnPosition/): Sets the player's spawn position (where compass points and respawn occurs).
- [S06PacketUpdateHealth 0x06 — Update Health](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S06PacketUpdateHealth/): Updates the player's health, food level, and saturation. Sent ~20 times per second during combat.
- [S07PacketRespawn 0x07 — Respawn](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S07PacketRespawn/): Sends respawn or dimension change request. The client must reload the world (clear chunks, entities) and re-sync position.
- [S08PacketPlayerPosLook 0x08 — Player Position & Look](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S08PacketPlayerPosLook/): Forces the player to a specific position and rotation. The client must respond with a C04/05/06.
- [S09PacketHeldItemChange 0x09 — Held Item Change](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S09PacketHeldItemChange/): Server confirms the player's held item slot change (echo back of C09).
- [S0APacketUseBed 0x0A — Use Bed](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S0APacketUseBed/): Makes the player lie down in a bed at the specified position.
- [S0BPacketAnimation 0x0B — Animation](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S0BPacketAnimation/): Broadcasts entity animation (arm swing, damage, etc.) to nearby players.
- [S0CPacketSpawnPlayer 0x0C — Spawn Player](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S0CPacketSpawnPlayer/): Spawns another player entity in the world with UUID, position (fixed-point int × 32), rotation (byte × 256/360), held item, and metadata.
- [S0DPacketCollectItem 0x0D — Collect Item](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S0DPacketCollectItem/): Shows an item being collected (picked up) by a player entity. Plays the pickup animation.
- [S0EPacketSpawnObject 0x0E — Spawn Object](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S0EPacketSpawnObject/): Spawns a non-living entity: item drop, boat, minecart, arrow, fireball, ender pearl, armor stand, etc.
- [S0FPacketSpawnMob 0x0F — Spawn Mob](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S0FPacketSpawnMob/): Spawns a living entity (mob/animal/monster) with entity type, position, rotation, velocity, and metadata.
- [S10PacketSpawnPainting 0x10 — Spawn Painting](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S10PacketSpawnPainting/): Spawns a painting entity with type, position, and facing direction.
- [S11PacketSpawnExperienceOrb 0x11 — Spawn Experience Orb](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S11PacketSpawnExperienceOrb/): Spawns an experience orb entity with position and XP value.
- [S12PacketEntityVelocity 0x12 — Entity Velocity](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S12PacketEntityVelocity/): Sets an entity's velocity (e.g., from knockback, explosion, piston push).
- [S13PacketDestroyEntities 0x13 — Destroy Entities](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S13PacketDestroyEntities/): Removes one or more entities from the client's render list.
- [S14PacketEntity 0x14 — Entity](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S14PacketEntity/): Base class for entity relative movement and rotation updates. Subclasses S15 (rel move), S16 (look), S17 (move+look).
- [S18PacketEntityTeleport 0x18 — Entity Teleport](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S18PacketEntityTeleport/): Teleports an entity to an absolute position (fixed-point int × 32) and rotation.
- [S19PacketEntityHeadLook 0x19 — Entity Head Look](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S19PacketEntityHeadLook/): Updates an entity's head yaw rotation independently of body rotation.
- [S19PacketEntityStatus 0x19 — Entity Status](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S19PacketEntityStatus/): Sends a status event for an entity (death sound, hurt effect, taming, wolf shaking, etc.).
- [S1BPacketEntityAttach 0x1B — Entity Attach](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S1BPacketEntityAttach/): Attaches an entity to another (player on horse, animal on leash, leach knot).
- [S1CPacketEntityMetadata 0x1C — Entity Metadata](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S1CPacketEntityMetadata/): Updates an entity's DataWatcher metadata (health, skin, flags, name, etc.).
- [S1DPacketEntityEffect 0x1D — Entity Effect](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S1DPacketEntityEffect/): Applies a status/potion effect to an entity.
- [S1EPacketRemoveEntityEffect 0x1E — Remove Entity Effect](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S1EPacketRemoveEntityEffect/): Removes a potion effect from an entity.
- [S1FPacketSetExperience 0x1F — Set Experience](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S1FPacketSetExperience/): Updates the player's experience bar (level, total XP, progress).
- [S20PacketEntityProperties 0x20 — Entity Properties](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S20PacketEntityProperties/): Updates an entity's generic attributes (movement speed, max health, knockback resistance, etc.).
- [S21PacketChunkData 0x21 — Chunk Data](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S21PacketChunkData/): Sends a chunk section (16x16x16 blocks) with compressed block data, light values, and biome info.
- [S22PacketMultiBlockChange 0x22 — Multi Block Change](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S22PacketMultiBlockChange/): Updates multiple blocks within a single chunk. More efficient than sending many S23 packets.
- [S23PacketBlockChange 0x23 — Block Change](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S23PacketBlockChange/): Updates a single block in the world — position and new block state (combined ID+metadata).
- [S24PacketBlockAction 0x24 — Block Action](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S24PacketBlockAction/): Triggers a block action animation/event (chest open, piston extend, note block play, etc.).
- [S25PacketBlockBreakAnim 0x25 — Block Break Animation](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S25PacketBlockBreakAnim/): Shows block break progress (crack stages 0-9) on a block. Sent by all players, not just the miner.
- [S26PacketMapChunkBulk 0x26 — Map Chunk Bulk](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S26PacketMapChunkBulk/): Sends multiple chunks at once. Used for initial world load and large area updates.
- [S27PacketExplosion 0x27 — Explosion](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S27PacketExplosion/): Server notifies the client of an explosion (TNT, creeper, bed in Nether/End, etc).
- [S28PacketEffect 0x28 — Effect](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S28PacketEffect/): Plays a sound effect or particle effect at a position (without a named sound).
- [S29PacketSoundEffect 0x29 — Sound Effect](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S29PacketSoundEffect/): Plays a named sound at a world position with volume and pitch.
- [S2APacketParticles 0x2A — Particles](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S2APacketParticles/): Spawns particle effects at a position with offset, speed, and count.
- [S2BPacketChangeGameState 0x2B — Change Game State](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S2BPacketChangeGameState/): Changes a global game state: rain toggle, gamemode change, credits, demo messages, elder guardian effect.
- [S2CPacketSpawnGlobalEntity 0x2C — Spawn Global Entity](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S2CPacketSpawnGlobalEntity/): Spawns a global entity visible to all players (lightning bolt).
- [S2DPacketOpenWindow 0x2D — Open Window](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S2DPacketOpenWindow/): Opens an inventory GUI window (chest, crafting table, furnace, enchantment table, etc.) with window ID, type, title, and slot count.
- [S2EPacketCloseWindow 0x2E — Close Window](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S2EPacketCloseWindow/): Server forces the client to close an inventory window.
- [S2FPacketSetSlot 0x2F — Set Slot](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S2FPacketSetSlot/): Sets a single slot in an inventory window. Used for cursor updates, specific slot changes, and armor slot updates.
- [S30PacketWindowItems 0x30 — Window Items](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S30PacketWindowItems/): Sends the full contents of an inventory window — all slots at once. Used for initial container opening and rejected transaction recovery.
- [S31PacketWindowProperty 0x31 — Window Property](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S31PacketWindowProperty/): Updates a single property in a container (enchantment level, furnace burn time, brewing progress, etc.).
- [S32PacketConfirmTransaction 0x32 — Confirm Transaction](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S32PacketConfirmTransaction/): Server confirms or rejects an inventory transaction from C0EPacketClickWindow. accepted=false causes client to revert inventory.
- [S33PacketUpdateSign 0x33 — Update Sign](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S33PacketUpdateSign/): Updates a sign's text for all nearby players.
- [S34PacketMaps 0x34 — Maps](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S34PacketMaps/): Updates a map item's data (pixels, colors).
- [S35PacketUpdateTileEntity 0x35 — Update Tile Entity](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S35PacketUpdateTileEntity/): Updates NBT data for a tile entity (sign, skull, beacon, command block, etc.).
- [S36PacketSignEditorOpen 0x36 — Sign Editor Open](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S36PacketSignEditorOpen/): Opens the sign editor GUI for a specific sign position.
- [S37PacketStatistics 0x37 — Statistics](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S37PacketStatistics/): Updates statistic values (walk distance, damage dealt, items crafted, etc.).
- [S38PacketPlayerListItem 0x38 — Player List Item](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S38PacketPlayerListItem/): Adds, updates, or removes entries from the tab player list. Used for player join/leave, gamemode changes, ping updates, and display name changes.
- [S39PacketPlayerAbilities 0x39 — Player Abilities](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S39PacketPlayerAbilities/): Server updates the player's capabilities (flying, invulnerable, creative, fly speed, walk speed).
- [S3APacketTabComplete 0x3A — Tab Complete](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S3APacketTabComplete/): Server responds to C14PacketTabComplete with a list of matching commands/player names.
- [S3BPacketScoreboardObjective 0x3B — Scoreboard Objective](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S3BPacketScoreboardObjective/): Creates or removes a scoreboard objective (the scoreboard itself, not individual scores).
- [S3CPacketUpdateScore 0x3C — Update Score](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S3CPacketUpdateScore/): Updates a single scoreboard entry (add, remove, or change score value).
- [S3DPacketDisplayScoreboard 0x3D — Display Scoreboard](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S3DPacketDisplayScoreboard/): Sets which scoreboard objective is displayed in a position (sidebar, list, below name).
- [S3EPacketTeams 0x3E — Teams](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S3EPacketTeams/): Create/update/remove a scoreboard team. Manages team name, prefix/suffix, players, friendly fire, and nametag visibility.
- [S3FPacketCustomPayload 0x3F — Custom Payload (Plugin Message)](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S3FPacketCustomPayload/): Sends a plugin channel message from server to client. Used for mod/plugin communication.
- [S40PacketDisconnect 0x40 — Disconnect (Play)](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S40PacketDisconnect/): Kicks the player from the server during gameplay with a JSON chat component reason message.
- [S41PacketServerDifficulty 0x41 — Server Difficulty](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S41PacketServerDifficulty/): Informs client of the server's difficulty setting.
- [S42PacketCombatEvent 0x42 — Combat Event](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S42PacketCombatEvent/): Server sends combat-related events: enter combat, end combat, entity dead with death message.
- [S43PacketCamera 0x43 — Camera](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S43PacketCamera/): Sets the player's camera to spectate a specific entity (spectator mode teleport).
- [S44PacketWorldBorder 0x44 — World Border](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S44PacketWorldBorder/): Updates the world border (center, size, warning distance/buffer, damping).
- [S45PacketTitle 0x45 — Title](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S45PacketTitle/): Displays titles/subtitles on screen with animation timing. Actions: TITLE, SUBTITLE, TIMES, CLEAR, RESET.
- [S46PacketSetCompressionLevel 0x46 — Set Compression Level](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S46PacketSetCompressionLevel/): Changes the compression threshold mid-game. Same as S03 but for PLAY state.
- [S47PacketPlayerListHeaderFooter 0x47 — Player List Header Footer](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S47PacketPlayerListHeaderFooter/): Sets text above and below the tab player list.
- [S48PacketResourcePackSend 0x48 — Resource Pack Send](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S48PacketResourcePackSend/): Sends a resource pack URL and hash. Client downloads and applies it.
- [S49PacketUpdateEntityNBT 0x49 — Update Entity NBT](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/packets/S49PacketUpdateEntityNBT/): Updates the NBT data of an entity (used for command block minecarts, spawned entities with custom NBT).

## Logic Classes (16 — full MCP sources + analysis)
- [EntityPlayerSP](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/EntityPlayerSP/): Client player entity: emits C03 movement, C0A swings, C0B actions and C0C input every tick from onUpdateWalkingPlayer. Packets: C01PacketChatMessage, C03PacketPlayer, C07PacketPlayerDigging, C0APacketAnimation, C0BPacketEntityAction, C0CPacketInput, C0DPacketCloseWindow, C13PacketPlayerAbilities, C16PacketClientStatus.
- [EntityPlayerMP](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/EntityPlayerMP/): Server player entity: health, XP and inventory sync fan out S06, S1F, S2F and S30 packets from onUpdateEntity. Packets: S02PacketChat, S06PacketUpdateHealth, S0APacketUseBed, S0BPacketAnimation, S13PacketDestroyEntities, S19PacketEntityStatus, S1BPacketEntityAttach, S1DPacketEntityEffect, S1EPacketRemoveEntityEffect, S1FPacketSetExperience, S21PacketChunkData, S26PacketMapChunkBulk, S29PacketSoundEffect, S2BPacketChangeGameState, S2DPacketOpenWindow, S2EPacketCloseWindow, S2FPacketSetSlot, S30PacketWindowItems, S31PacketWindowProperty, S36PacketSignEditorOpen, S39PacketPlayerAbilities, S3FPacketCustomPayload, S42PacketCombatEvent, S43PacketCamera, S48PacketResourcePackSend.
- [EntityTrackerEntry](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/EntityTrackerEntry/): Server per-entity tracker: builds spawn packets and pushes S12 velocity, S14 movement and S18 teleports to tracking players. Packets: S04PacketEntityEquipment, S0APacketUseBed, S0CPacketSpawnPlayer, S0EPacketSpawnObject, S0FPacketSpawnMob, S10PacketSpawnPainting, S11PacketSpawnExperienceOrb, S12PacketEntityVelocity, S14PacketEntity, S18PacketEntityTeleport, S19PacketEntityHeadLook, S1BPacketEntityAttach, S1CPacketEntityMetadata, S1DPacketEntityEffect, S20PacketEntityProperties, S49PacketUpdateEntityNBT.
- [ServerConfigurationManager](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/ServerConfigurationManager/): Login/join orchestrator: fires S01 JoinGame, S38 tab-list, S39 abilities and S41 difficulty during initializeConnectionToPlayer. Packets: S01PacketJoinGame, S02PacketChat, S03PacketTimeUpdate, S05PacketSpawnPosition, S07PacketRespawn, S09PacketHeldItemChange, S1DPacketEntityEffect, S1FPacketSetExperience, S2BPacketChangeGameState, S38PacketPlayerListItem, S39PacketPlayerAbilities, S3EPacketTeams, S3FPacketCustomPayload, S41PacketServerDifficulty, S44PacketWorldBorder.
- [NetHandlerPlayServer](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/NetHandlerPlayServer/): Server play-state net handler: validates every C-packet (processPlayer movement gates, C02 reach, C0E clicks) and sends S08 corrections. Packets: S00PacketKeepAlive, S02PacketChat, S07PacketRespawn, S08PacketPlayerPosLook, S18PacketEntityTeleport, S23PacketBlockChange, S2FPacketSetSlot, S32PacketConfirmTransaction, S3APacketTabComplete, S40PacketDisconnect.
- [NetHandlerPlayClient](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/NetHandlerPlayClient/): Client play-state net handler: handle<Entity> dispatch for every S-packet plus C00/C03/C0F/C17/C19 replies upstream. Packets: C00PacketKeepAlive, C03PacketPlayer, C0FPacketConfirmTransaction, C17PacketCustomPayload, C19PacketResourcePackStatus.
- [WorldServer](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/WorldServer/): Server world: broadcasts S24 block actions, S27 explosions, S2A particles and S2C lightning to nearby players. Packets: S19PacketEntityStatus, S24PacketBlockAction, S27PacketExplosion, S2APacketParticles, S2BPacketChangeGameState, S2CPacketSpawnGlobalEntity.
- [PlayerControllerMP](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/PlayerControllerMP/): Client interaction controller: attackEntity/interact send C02, clickBlock sends C07, windowClick sends C0E, slot sync sends C10. Packets: C02PacketUseEntity, C07PacketPlayerDigging, C08PacketPlayerBlockPlacement, C09PacketHeldItemChange, C0EPacketClickWindow, C10PacketCreativeInventoryAction, C11PacketEnchantItem.
- [ServerScoreboard](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/ServerScoreboard/): Server scoreboard: objective/team/score mutations broadcast S3B, S3C, S3D and S3E to all players. Packets: S3BPacketScoreboardObjective, S3CPacketUpdateScore, S3DPacketDisplayScoreboard, S3EPacketTeams.
- [NetHandlerLoginServer](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/NetHandlerLoginServer/): Server login state machine (HELLO/KEY/AUTHENTICATING/READY): S01 encryption challenge, S02 success, S03 compression. Packets: S00PacketDisconnect, S01PacketEncryptionRequest, S02PacketLoginSuccess, S03PacketEnableCompression.
- [WorldManager](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/WorldManager/): Server world listener: relays S25 break progress, S28 effects and S29 sounds to players near the event. Packets: S25PacketBlockBreakAnim, S28PacketEffect, S29PacketSoundEffect.
- [PlayerManager](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/PlayerManager/): Chunk watch manager: streams S21 chunk data, S22 multi-block deltas and S26 bulk loads to watching players. Packets: S21PacketChunkData, S22PacketMultiBlockChange, S23PacketBlockChange.
- [EntityLivingBase](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/EntityLivingBase/): Living-entity base: swingItem, potion-effect add/remove and item pickup emit S0B, S1D/S1E and S0D through the tracker. Packets: S04PacketEntityEquipment, S0BPacketAnimation, S0DPacketCollectItem.
- [OldServerPinger](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/OldServerPinger/): Server-list prober: C00Handshake(47, STATUS) + C00 query + C01 ping sequence feeding the multiplayer latency readout. Packets: C00Handshake, C00PacketServerQuery, C01PacketPing.
- [NetHandlerStatusServer](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/NetHandlerStatusServer/): Server status responder: answers C00 query with S00 JSON and C01 ping with S01 echo, then closes the channel. Packets: S00PacketServerInfo, S01PacketPong.
- [ItemInWorldManager](https://realcrystalnight.github.io/mc-packet-reference/classes/ItemInWorldManager/): Survival interaction handler: block break/place and creative resync emit S23 corrections and S38 list updates. Packets: S23PacketBlockChange, S38PacketPlayerListItem.

## Protocol states
- Handshaking: C00Handshake
- Login: C00PacketLoginStart, C01PacketEncryptionResponse, S00PacketDisconnect, S01PacketEncryptionRequest, S02PacketLoginSuccess, S03PacketEnableCompression
- Status: C00PacketServerQuery, C01PacketPing, S00PacketServerInfo, S01PacketPong
- Play: 23 serverbound + 71 clientbound packets, see /packets/ index.
